record.question: Who was appointed as the CEO of Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) Mutual Fund recently?
record.explanation: Answer C: Dinesh Pangtey. LIC Mutual Fund appointed Dinesh Pangtey as CEO in May 2019. Reference: https://www.newsvoir.com/index.php/release/mr-dinesh-pangtey-appointed-as-ceo-of-lic-mutual-fund-11827.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
